description: Common easing curves as CSS-style cubic-bezier control points (x1, y1, x2, y2), with suggested motion uses and starting durations at 30 fps. Durations are starting points, not rules.

curves.name: Linear
curves.use: Constant motion: rotating loaders, tickers, scrolling backgrounds

curves.name: Ease-in
curves.use: Leaving: a layer exits the frame or fades away

curves.name: Ease-out
curves.use: Arriving: a title or logo enters and settles

curves.name: Ease-in-out
curves.use: Travelling between two visible positions, pans and zooms

curves.name: Overshoot
curves.use: Pop: stickers, emoji and captions that pass the target and settle back
